article.description: A negative result on insider-buying clusters in 470,754 SEC Form 4 records.
article.headline: The insider-buying edge was mostly 2008

citation: We looked for the insider-buying edge in 470,754 Form 4 records and, outside 2008–09, did not find it
description: Forty years of research said insiders beat the market. In 470,754 SEC Form 4 records, two years supplied 94% of the excess return.
title: The insider-buying edge was mostly 2008 — donttrade
